title: EasySqueeze Toothpaste Squeezer & Holder
author: codrey
description:
Hi everyone!

**Model**

This innovative Toothpaste Squeezer not only ensures you squeeze out every last drop of toothpaste but also provides tidy storage. With its built-in position lock and threaded cap, it effectively prevents any wasteful unraveling of your toothpaste, giving you both efficiency and organization in one sleek design.

**Assembly**

Assembling your Toothpaste Squeezer is effortless. Start by inserting the end of the Key into the hexagonal divot in the Turner. No need for glue; the tolerance is finely adjusted for a seamless click-in fit. Then, position the Turner and Key into the Tube. Align the slot in the key with the corresponding slot in the tube and smoothly push in your toothpaste. Finally, secure everything in place by threading on the cap over the top of the key.

Upgrade your oral care routine with this Toothpaste Squeezer - the perfect companion for squeezing out every bit of freshness from your toothpaste while keeping your bathroom clutter-free. Make the switch and never struggle with toothpaste tubes again!

I'd love to see your completed builds. Don't forget to ❤️ Like and ⭐️ Rate!

Enjoy!
